title: Power Architecture Dossiers
mission: Turn the Power Architecture Watchlist into target-specific public-record dossiers: infrastructure controlled, confirmed public power rails, missing records, source routes and next pulls.
boundary: These are accountability dossiers, not verdict pages. They track public power rails and records needed for scrutiny. No claim is upgraded beyond the record supporting it.

dossiers.name: Elon Musk
dossiers.headline: Space, satellites, social distribution, AI and mobility data in one private power stack.
dossiers.corePower: SpaceX and Starlink create communications and launch infrastructure; Tesla creates mobility/software data and energy systems; X creates information distribution; xAI adds model infrastructure; Neuralink adds brain-computer interface research.
confirmedRails: Space launch and satellite communications lane through SpaceX and Starlink.
Mobility, vehicle-software and energy infrastructure lane through Tesla.
Social platform and information-distribution lane through X.
Frontier AI lane through xAI.
Neurotechnology research lane through Neuralink.
publicQuestions: Which government and defence contracts shape Starlink and SpaceX deployment?
What data policies govern X, Tesla and xAI integration or separation?
What regulator records exist for Neuralink and Tesla systems?
What public statements define platform moderation, government requests and data retention?
dossiers.nextPull: Build contract and policy map: SpaceX/Starlink, Tesla, X, xAI, Neuralink.

Cloud infrastructure and public-sector systems lane.
Healthcare-data lane through Oracle Health/Cerner.
AI infrastructure lane through Stargate-related public announcements.
publicQuestions: Which public-sector cloud contracts and health-data systems are attached to Oracle?

dossiers.nextPull: Build Oracle/Ellison dossier from filings, public-sector cloud routes, Oracle Health records and Stargate source routes.
